name: imgview
description: Preview images inside Claude Code: each image a reply names, and each image pasted into a prompt, gets a chip. Click a chip to open the picture in a pane. Set the preview option to show a small picture under each chip that scrolls with the text, or to pop it up when the pointer is on the chip. /img <path> opens any image. Pixels on kitty and Ghostty, colored block characters on every other terminal.

preview.title: Chip picture
preview.description: inline: a small picture under each chip, scrolling with the text. hover: the picture pops up while the pointer is on the chip.
